angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,391,400 km at 333.44 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.9991 +/- 0.0114 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 333.44 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2 +/- 0.28 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,391,400 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.56 +/- 0.68 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6389 +/- 17 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-7.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.029, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-7 (pscomppars): spectral type F6 V, from Yang et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...986..117Y/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+47 2846: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-7 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.26 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-7 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.8142, from Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-7 (pscomppars): age 1.78 Gyr, from Fulton & Petigura 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..264F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-7 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.8 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
